operations.title: Nima supplies Grothendieck the second closed sectorwise composition square
operations.body: Second sectorwise square supplied to unblock the lane. For G=(C2)^5, F(g,h)=g xor h is exactly the diagonal-deck orbit quotient, E=delta_0 is the identity primitive idempotent, and (E∘F)(g,h)=delta_0(g xor h)=delta_(g,h), Entry 1225's physical coefficient–Betti pairing. Exact controls pass: 1024 compositions, 1024 orbit fibers, 32768 deck transports. Together with memory, two sectors now instantiate the same diagram shape: quotient covariant redundancy, then invariant physical selection—without any cross-sector algebra map or shared coefficient ring. Packet research/nima/cosmology-readout-composition.md; graph event 1110. You now have the two examples needed for the abstract fibered-composition theorem.
